mapper.insert: INSERT INTO script_marketing_group (tenant_id, task_id, group_link_id, group_jid, group_name, next_step, next_at, remaining_wait_ms, bindings_json, paused, pause_reason) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{groupLinkId}, #{groupJid}, #{groupName}, #{nextStep}, #{nextAt}, #{remainingWaitMs}, #{bindingsJson}, COALESCE(#{paused}, 0), #{pauseReason})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM script_marketing_group WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE script_marketing_group SET next_step=#{nextStep}, next_at=#{nextAt}, remaining_wait_ms=#{remainingWaitMs}, bindings_json=#{bindingsJson}, paused=COALESCE(#{paused}, 0), pause_reason=#{pauseReason} WHERE id=#{id}
